what_this_is: NOT a measurement. The expected verdict for every commit of a SYNTHETIC repository
that `amendguard.py calibrate` builds itself, written from the rule in
docs/record-vs-pointer.md and then compared against the run — never the other way
round. No entry here names a commit, a path or a count in this repository.
An instrument that has not been shown to distinguish an edited record from a
corrected pointer is not evidence about either, so if any row flips, nothing
amendguard says about any real commit may be believed.

the_pair_that_must_not_flip.must_be_red: RECORD-EDITED — a number rewritten in place, alone, in a document that is amend-only
the_pair_that_must_not_flip.must_be_green: POINTER-P3-SOLE — a file:line pin corrected in place, in its own commit, touching nothing else

the_pair_amendment_1_demanded.must_be_red: BARE-GATE — a gate expectation carrying neither a co-moving-count marker nor a (value, commit, command) provenance stamp
the_pair_amendment_1_demanded.must_be_green: STAMPED-GATE — the same number carrying a full stamp. Green here means FALSIFIABLE, not CORRECT: the checker never learns whether 932 is right.

found_by_running_it: MARKER-QUOTED — a co-moving-count marker shown inside a fenced example is quoted, not declared. The first field run of this checker, over its own design document, reported COUNT-STALE against a count that document never claimed. The fix is the same rule the fence already carries for pins, and this row is what keeps it fixed.
one_case_per_closed_list_ENTRY: POINTER-P3-SECTION and POINTER-P3-BACKTICK — the two P3 sub-forms that had no case. `classify` reports the CLASS, so all three P3 sub-forms read `pointer:P3`, and a coverage guard counting class ids was satisfied for all three by the path form alone: six closed-list entries, four ids. Measured both ways before the guard was fixed — deleting the bare-backtick entry, and adding a seventh sub-form with no case, each left the suite at 24 passed and the sweep at flips=0.
the_triple_that_had_no_case: PARTIAL-STAMP — a provenance stamp carrying value and commit but not command. Invariant 5 makes the (value, commit, command) triple the entire fallback for a cross-artifact co-moving count, and `STAMP_REQUIRED_KEYS = ()` passed with flips=0 before this row existed.

the_pair_the_amendment_class_demanded.must_be_green: AMEND-IN-PLACE — a register row struck and given a closure INSIDE its own line. Nothing is destroyed, so it is an amendment and not a rewrite.
the_pair_the_amendment_class_demanded.must_be_red: AMEND-BUT-DELETES — the same extension, far longer, with ONE character of the sentence gone. Green here would mean the predicate is a length test. MEASURED 2026-09-11: the ledger had registered a strict-PREFIX test for this class, and over `6e506ca..df48b68` with the register files gated that test greens 0 of the 7 RECORD-EDITED hunks, because a table row ends in `|` and a closure never lands at the end of the line. The character-level test greens 5 and leaves 2, and those 2 destroyed text.

the_rbp47_input: VERBATIM-PIN — a file:line pin inside a fenced verbatim block. A pointer by syntax, a record by context. classify and the closed list disagree on it, which is why their agreement elsewhere is a cross-check and not a transcription.
